text.p: These are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Environmentalists dismiss report in Sunday Times of London that Malta is among biggest importers of garden birds for eating.
- Examiners' report slams student skills, saying Maltese primary school students sitting for exams to join secondary schools lack originality and attention to spelling and grammar rules.

- Opposition leader Eddie Fenech Adami says ferry fares to Gozo will harm sister island's economy. The fare increase were announced by the government at the end of January. On Saturday the governemnt announced a partial climbdown, reducing some of the new fares. Fenech Adami said fares were still too high.
